walk_title_1: ଲାଇଭ୍ ସହାୟତା ସହ ସିପିଆର୍ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରନ୍ତୁ
walk_rescuer_body: ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ମାଡ଼ି ବସି ତକିଆ ଉପରେ ଦବାନ୍ତି। କେବଳ ଆପ୍ ର କଥା ଶୁଣନ୍ତି।
walk_holder_body: ପାଖରେ ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ଫୋନ୍ କୁ ଆଡ଼େଇ ଧରି ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍ ଦେଖନ୍ତି।
em_step_push: ତାଳ ସହିତ ଛାତି ଜୋରରେ ଓ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଦବାନ୍ତୁ।
em_setup_hint: ଫୋନ୍‌କୁ ପାଖରୁ ଧରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଉଦ୍ଧାରକାରୀଙ୍କ ପାଖ ଆଡ଼େ ମୁହାଁଇ ଭୂଇଁରେ ଆଉଜାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
em_summary_note: କ୍ୟାମେରା ହାତ ଦେଖିପାରୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ହିଁ ଗତି ଓ ବିରତି ଗଣାଯାଇଛି।
cprGuideIntro: Five clear steps for an unresponsive adult who is not breathing normally.
cprGuideScope: For adults. If this is happening now, call 112 and follow the dispatcher.
cprStep1Body: Make sure it is safe to approach. Tap their shoulders and speak loudly. If there is no response, gently tilt the head back and lift the chin. Check for normal breathing for no more than 10 seconds. Gasping is not normal breathing.
cprStep1Tip: If they are breathing normally, do not start compressions; follow the dispatcher.
cprStep1Visual: Check for a response and normal breathing.
cprStep2Body: Call 112 on speakerphone, or ask someone else to call. Ask a helper to bring an AED. If you are alone, do not leave the person to look for one.
cprStep2Visual: Call for help and ask someone to bring an AED.
cprStep3Body: Kneel beside the adult on a firm surface. Put the heel of one hand in the centre of the chest on the lower half of the breastbone, place the other hand on top and interlock your fingers.
cprStep3Tip: Keep your shoulders above your hands and your arms straight.
cprStep3Visual: Stack your hands over the lower half of the breastbone.
cprStep4Body: Press straight down about 5–6 cm at 100–120 compressions per minute. Let the chest come back up fully between pushes and keep interruptions short.
cprStep4Tip: If trained and willing, give 2 rescue breaths after every 30 compressions. Otherwise, keep doing chest compressions.
cprStep4Visual: Straight arms above the chest, pressing down and releasing.
cprStep5Body: Switch on the AED, place the pads as its diagrams show and follow its spoken instructions. Do not touch the person while it analyses or delivers a shock.
cprStep5Tip: Resume compressions when the AED tells you. Continue until help takes over or the person breathes normally.
cprStep5Visual: One pad on the upper right chest; one on the left side below the armpit. Follow the device’s diagrams.
